$jsonSchema.title: AI Recommendation Schema
$jsonSchema.description: Validation schema for the ai_recommendation collection - AI-generated recommendations for menus

user_id.description: Reference to user._id - whose preferences these recommendations are based on

menu_id.description: Reference to menu._id - which menu these recommendations are for

summary.description: AI-generated summary/explanation of recommendations based on user preferences
examples: Based on your preference for spicy Italian dishes and vegetarian options, we recommend...
These selections match your liked cuisines and avoid all your allergies...
